<Luxembourg> is a small country located in the [Low Countries](Low_Countries "Low Countries"), part of [North-West Europe](North-West_Europe "North-West Europe") It borders <Belgium> for 148 kilometres (92 miles) to the west and north, <France> (73 km [45 mi]) to the south, and <Germany> (138 km [86 mi]) to the east. Luxembourg is landlocked, separated from the [North Sea](North_Sea "North Sea") by Belgium.

The topography of the country is divided very clearly between the hilly <Oesling> of the northern third of the Grand Duchy and the flat [Gutland](Gutland_(Luxembourg) "Gutland (Luxembourg)"), which occupies the southern two-thirds. The country's longest river is the <Sauer>, which is a [tributary](Tributary "Tributary") of the [Moselle](Moselle_(river) "Moselle (river)"), the basin of which includes almost all of Luxembourg's area. Other major rivers include the <Alzette> in the south and the [Wiltz](Wiltz_River "Wiltz River") in the north.

The [capital](Capital_(political) "Capital (political)"), and by far the largest city, is [Luxembourg City](Luxembourg_City "Luxembourg City"), which is located in the Gutland, as are most of the country's main population centres, including <Esch-sur-Alzette>, <Dudelange>, and <Differdange>. Besides Luxembourg City, the other main towns are primarily located in the southern [Red Lands](Red_Lands "Red Lands") region, which lines the border between Luxembourg and France to the south.
